subtitle: Waste Management System
jcr:title: Neptune 3
jcr:description: Neptune 3 is a constantly closed fluid, smoke, and aerosol filtration system that comes with standard integration of HEPA and ULPA filtration.

largeheadline.line2: Our goal is zero splashes and spills

text.text:
Neptune 3 is the only constantly closed waste management system on the market, where constant containment of surgical fluid, smoke, and airborne pathogens is possible. Filtration comes standard with Neptune 3’s fully integrated HEPA and ULPA filters.

Alongside Neptune 3’s simple workflow and consistent suction, the system works to protect you from suctioned pathogens.

text_654000976.text: The risk of HIV transmission via fluid exposure is approximately 1 out of 1,000 incident.1

text_copy.text: Neptune offers up to 3.5x more efficient in room set-up, handling and maintenance when compared to an open system.²

text.text: Estimating fluid volume of traditional suction canisters yields error margins as high as 15%.³
0 splashing, spilling or exposure observed when the constantly closed system was in use.2, 4, 5

largeheadline_copy.line1:
Neptune 3 
Our goal is zero splashes & spills

text_copy_copy.text:
A) Track fluid volume per case
or in a specific period of time. With the press of a button, fluid volume rests to zero on the main digital display.

B) Neptune 3’s 4L lighted canister
provides readouts in 10mL increments, and is validated to a meticulous fluid accuracy of +- 50mL.

C) Neptune 3 features two independently controlled and regulated canisters,
establishing separate lines of suction, volume measurements and customized suction settings. Hush vacuum pump produces a noise level of just 4.3 sones.

D) Integrated smoke evacuation: 80 hour ULPA filter,
10 speed settings plus an auto mode that detects surgical smoke and adjusts flow.

E) Powered IV pole
with auto retraction comes standard; holds four 3L bags on “ram’s horn” hooks. 

F) Smart equipment manager (SEM)
A cloud-based application that provides real-time rover insights such as maintenance needs, rover location, total run time and more.

largeheadline_copy.line1: A smooth-running OR

text.text:
Minimize exposure

  • Seal Shut technology and HEPA filtration locks away suctioned biohazards.
  • Constantly closed system; reduces physical touchpoints and potential exposure to biohazards.

text_copy.text:
Reduce OR turn over time

  • Permits patient-to-patient use, requiring only change of the single use manifold.
  • 24L capacity allows for fluid stacking without having to clean between cases.6

Protect staff

  • Built-in smoke evacuator helps protect against surgical smoke carrying chemicals, bacteria, viruses, blood fragments and other irritants.7,8
  • Electromagnetic couplers automatically engage at the docking station, meaning no lids to handle, no hoses to insert and no canisters to dump.

text.text:
“If it comes between doing what’s right and what’s easy, all of us should do what’s right.”

– Tom Siemers, CEO Dosher Memorial Hospital, on going smoke-free with Stryker Neptune 3 and SafeAir
